description: This file defines the UploadedFileFactoryInterface, an interface for creating uploaded file instances within the PSR-7 HTTP message implementation, specifying method signatures for creating uploaded files with metadata and error handling.

classes.name: UploadedFileFactoryInterface
classes.description: An interface declaring a method for creating uploaded file objects with specified parameters and error handling.

methods.name: createUploadedFile
methods.description: Creates a new uploaded file object with provided stream, size, error status, filename, and media type.
